GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifetd back 7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
Jumped Ok to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, drew 1 length clear 200m, half clear 100m, kept on well late, just did enough # led/kicked/fell in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rdr reported it was not his intention to lead, however after beginning well and after finding a prominent position early, the gelding commenced to race keenly and rather than restrain he allowed it to improve forward whereby he was able to obtain the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: was a Bit Slow Out , Settled Down a Clear last 10 Lengths @ 900m. Hooked Out all Clear Straightening Up . found line well # good from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid out rounding the home turn. Near the 400m and again approaching the 350m was inconvenienced when carried wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well widest. went back Clear last 7 Lengths @ 800m. Ridden Along Straightening Up Hooked Out widest. $1.40 winner had skipped Clear but this finished off well # solid from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: The gelding underwent a pre-race vet exam and was cleared to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, battled on ok but never a threat # did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and soon after was bumped. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the off-hind leg. Tnr was told a vet clearance will be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 3-4l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, hit line well without threatening # hit line well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly.  Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 800m, shifted out and bumped. The gelding continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages. Laid out rounding the home turn. Had some difficulty securing clear running between the 250m and 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped Just Ok . Settled Down 3 Wide 7th 6 Lengths @ 650m. Ridden Along Straightening Up all Clear . Just couldn't quicken at all (vetted - all clear. rider 'raced too keen, left without a finish) # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Rdr reported after being fractious in the barriers, beginning awkwardly and losing significant ground, he was obliged to make some use of his mnt to obtain a position near midfield. Std the gelding however raced too keenly throughout the middle stages and as a result was left without a finishing effort.  A post-race vet exam revealed no significant abs.
